description: This file defines a set of utility functions for creating and managing lazy-loaded runtime modules, surfaces, and methods with caching and dynamic import capabilities in TypeScript.

methods.name: export function createLazyRuntimeSurface<TModule, TSurface>( createLazyRuntimeSurface
methods.description: Creates a lazily loaded surface from a module importer and a selector function, caching the result.

methods.name: export function createLazyRuntimeModule<TModule>( createLazyRuntimeModule
methods.description: Creates a lazily loaded module loader that caches the imported module.

methods.name: export function createLazyRuntimeNamedExport<TModule, const TKey extends keyof TModule>( createLazyRuntimeNamedExport
methods.description: Creates a lazy loader for a specific named export from a dynamically imported module.

methods.name: export function createLazyRuntimeMethod<TSurface, TArgs extends unknown[], TResult>( createLazyRuntimeMethod
methods.description: Creates a lazily loaded method on a surface, enabling delayed execution with caching.

methods.name: export function createLazyRuntimeMethodBinder<TSurface>(load: () => Promise<TSurface>) { createLazyRuntimeMethodBinder
methods.description: Returns a function to create lazy runtime methods, simplifying method creation with a shared module loader.
